title: Applied Forbidden
description: It allows Forbidden Arcanus's Starlight Forge and Pedestals to connect to the ME network, enabling automated rituals, resource management, and structure construction.
body:
Applied Forbidden is a NeoForge 1.21.1 mod that deeply integrates the network automation capabilities of Applied Energistics 2 with the magical machinery of Forbidden Arcanus.

It allows Forbidden Arcanus's Starlight Forge and Pedestals to connect to the ME network, enabling automated rituals, resource management, and structure construction.

## Automated Pedestal

- Connects to the AE2 network, serving as an external interface for ME storage
- Automatically extracts from and deposits items into the network
- Configurable channel usage and scan frequency
